description: Cooperative Transmission Expansion Planning Experiment Data and Results is a data set deposited in DOE Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) Repository by its authors Kerem Ziya Akdemir, Kendall Mongird. GO WEST is an open-source power grid modeling framework for U.S. Western Interconnection, which allows users to tailor the model depending on their research study and science questions. It covers 28 balancing authorities (BA) and 12 states in U.S. Western Interconnection. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata.
